description: Read-only public-sector spending and opportunity research CLI for USAspending awards, agency and vendor footprints, Grants.gov opportunities, and SAM.gov opportunity setup.

novel_features.name: Vendor footprint
novel_features.description: Searches USAspending awards for a recipient/vendor and rolls the returned page into agencies, categories, recent awards, source URL, and freshness caveats.

novel_features.name: Agency spend profile
novel_features.description: Matches a federal agency from USAspending references, then produces a compact recent-awards view for the matched agency name.

novel_features.name: Award search
novel_features.description: Searches USAspending awards by keyword, vendor, awarding agency, NAICS, PSC, and date window with dry-run request visibility.

novel_features.name: Grant opportunity search
novel_features.description: Searches the public Grants.gov search endpoint without credentials and reports opportunity number, title, agency, status, and open/close dates.

novel_features.name: SAM.gov opportunity setup
novel_features.description: Builds SAM.gov Opportunities API searches when GOVSPEND_SAM_API_KEY is configured and returns structured setup guidance when it is not.
